values: Atrazine chlorohydrolase from Pseudomonas sp. strain ADP: gene sequence, enzyme purification, and protein characterization.
Experimentally purified/characterized atrazine dechlorination enzyme; also supported by gene cloning publication PMID 7574646.
The atzB gene of Pseudomonas sp. strain ADP encodes the second enzyme of a novel atrazine degradation pathway.
Experimentally assigned second enzyme in atrazine degradation pathway; later mechanistic work PMID 17660279.
AtzC is a new member of the amidohydrolase protein superfamily and is homologous to other atrazine-metabolizing enzymes.
Experimentally characterized atrazine pathway enzyme; purified substrate-range work PMID 12218024.
Isolation and characterisation of Nocardioides sp. SP12, an atrazine-degrading bacterial strain possessing the gene trzN from bulk- and maize rhizosphere soil.
Experimentally isolated atrazine-degrading strain possessing trzN; accession lacks RefSeq cross-reference in UniProt.
Cloning and sequencing of a plasmid-borne gene (opd) encoding a phosphotriesterase.
Parathion hydrolase specified by the Flavobacterium opd gene: relationship between the gene and protein.
Experimentally linked opd gene to parathion hydrolase protein from ATCC 27551.
Isolation of methyl parathion-degrading strain M6 and cloning of the methyl parathion hydrolase gene.
Experimentally isolated methyl-parathion degrader and cloned hydrolase gene.
Plasmid-borne catabolism of methyl parathion and p-nitrophenol in Pseudomonas sp. strain WBC-3.
Experimentally studied methyl parathion catabolism; protein structure also reported PMID 16181636.
Cloning of mpd gene from a chlorpyrifos-degrading bacterium and use of this strain in bioremediation of contaminated soil.
Experimentally linked mpd to chlorpyrifos-degrading bacterium; useful organophosphate supplement.
Improving methyl parathion hydrolase to enhance its chlorpyrifos-hydrolysing efficiency.
Experimentally assayed engineered/improved chlorpyrifos hydrolysis; include with note if you allow enzyme variants.
Nucleotide sequence and genetic structure of a novel carbaryl hydrolase gene (cehA) from Rhizobium sp. strain AC100.
Experimentally supported carbaryl hydrolase gene from degrader strain.
Cloning and nucleotide sequence of carbaryl hydrolase gene (cahA) from Arthrobacter sp. RC100.
Experimentally cloned carbaryl hydrolase gene; no RefSeq cross-reference in UniProt.
Experimentally reported enzyme; accession/source needs manual confirmation
UniProt record identifies mcd carbofuran hydrolase from Achromobacter sp. WM111; add primary citation before import.
Good candidate, but primary publication metadata was not present in UniProt query result; keep as REVIEW_BEFORE_IMPORT.
Cloning of a novel pyrethroid-hydrolyzing carboxylesterase gene from Sphingobium sp. strain JZ-1 and characterization of the gene product.
Reviewed UniProt enzyme; experimentally characterized pyrethroid hydrolysis.
Molecular cloning, purification, and biochemical characterization of a novel pyrethroid-hydrolyzing esterase from Klebsiella sp. strain ZD112.
Reviewed UniProt enzyme; strong biochemical evidence.
